cards.meaning: to remove; to take off or out (something attached)
cards.example: Tatanggalin ng Senado ang mga proyektong hindi pumasa sa pagsusuri.
cards.exampleMeaning: The Senate will remove the projects that failed review.
cards.note: Karaniwan, hindi pormal o balbal. Mas may ideya ng pagkakahiwalay kaysa 'alisin'. Mas matigas kapag tao ang tinanggal ('tinanggal sa puwesto').
cards.tiesTo: Senate removing ~295 DPWH projects from the 2027 budget

cards.example: Nagpakita ng pagkakaisa ang mayorya ng Senado sa paglilinis ng badyet.
cards.exampleMeaning: The Senate majority showed unity in cleaning up the budget.
cards.note: Pormal; madalas sa talumpati at balita ng politika. Mas buo kaysa 'pagsang-ayon'; iba sa 'pagkakasundo' (pagkaayos matapos ang away).
cards.tiesTo: Senate majority united behind the budget purge

cards.example: 华发的债券大幅下跌，不过公司仍然在偿还部分债务。
cards.examplePinyin: Huáfā de zhàiquàn dàfú xiàdié, búguò gōngsī réngrán zài chánghuán bùfen zhàiwù.
cards.exampleMeaning: Huafa's bonds fell sharply, however the company is still repaying part of its debt.
cards.note: 口语,语气比'但是'轻,先让步再转折;'然而'是书面语。Spoken and softer than 但是; 然而 is written.

cards.example: 公司仍然没有公布具体数字。
cards.examplePinyin: Gōngsī réngrán méiyǒu gōngbù jùtǐ shùzì.
cards.exampleMeaning: The company still hasn't released the specific figures.
cards.note: 中性偏书面;放在动词前,常跟在'虽然''不过'分句后。近义词'依然'更文学化。Near-synonym 依然 is more literary; never sentence-initial-feeling.
cards.tiesTo: Zhuhai Huafa — AAA rating and repayment despite the bond drop
